description: This file defines a static class Adler32Checksum that provides a method to calculate the Adler-32 checksum, used for ZLIB data in PDFsharp's PNG handling module. It includes the implementation of the checksum calculation following RFC 1950.

classes.name: Adler32Checksum
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating the Adler-32 checksum for byte data, according to RFC 1950.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the Adler-32 checksum for the provided data sequence, optionally up to the specified length.
